name: SikaBond® SprayFix
summary: SikaBond® SprayFix is a multipurpose, high performance, fast drying, mist spray adhesive designed to bond various materials, used for both temporary light and lasting high strength bonding applications.
metaDescription: SikaBond® SprayFix is a multipurpose, high performance, fast drying, mist spray adhesive designed to bond various materials, used for both temporary light and lasting high strength bonding applications.
attributes: Low odour - suitable for indoor use
Versatile – bonds well to many substrates
usage: SikaBond® SprayFix can be used on many substrates, including:
advantages: Low odour - suitable for indoor use
Versatile – bonds well to many substrates

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 24 months from the date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Must be stored in original, undamaged packaging, in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight, at temperatures between +10°C and +25°C

items.label: Pressing time
items.text: Apply even presurre to bonded surfaces for approximately 3 ~ 5 minutes

items.label: Consumption
items.text: Approximate coverage - 8m2 for single side temporary bonding and 4m2 for double sided permenant bonding

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: The surface must be clean, dry and free from oils, grease, dust and loose friable particles.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Tools and uncured overspray may be cleaned with Sika® Colma Cleaner or other suitable solvent. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.
